keyPhrases.text: generic ersatz Englishness, meandering score, and relentlessly one-joke construction
Best are the elegantly authentic Jim Norton
The audience I saw 'Drood' with adored it
the show still makes my teeth hurt

reasoning: Despite acknowledging talented performances and production values, the critic clearly states negative feelings from the opening ('considerably less than charmed') and concludes with 'the show still makes my teeth hurt.' The fundamental critique of the material itself as having a 'meandering score' and 'one-joke construction' outweighs praise for individual performances.
